description.narrative: 1. PROJECT DESCRIPTION - This initiative aims to empower women with disabilities and other vulnerable groups in vulnerable communities by establishing independent, sustainable, and environmentally friendly livelihoods. ⁃ We address the dual barriers (disability and gender) that severely restrict women with disabilities and other vulnerable groups in vulnerable access to formal employment. The project focuses on transforming locally sourced waste materials into high-value upcycled goods, promoting both economic inclusionand environmental responsibility. ⁃ Our comprehensive approach integrates vocational training, financial literacy, and cooperative business models, ensuring long-term self-reliance. This is a replicable model designed to shift the social perception of disability from dependency to productivity. 2. GOAL: To enhance the economic empowerment of women with disabilities through developing a production model for recycled products from plastic waste, while contributing to pollution reduction and raising community awareness of sustainable consumption. OBJECTIVES: ⁃ Strengthen the design and production skills of women with disabilities to create diverse, aesthetically appealing recycled products suitable for market demand. ⁃ Develop marketing and online sales channels (social media, e-commerce platforms) to expand market reach, strengthen branding, and increase customer engagement. ⁃ Improve organizational and operational skills among women with disabilities in business management, coordination, and planning, ensuring self-reliance and sustainability beyond the project period. ⁃ Create stable employment, improve income, and promote women’s participation in green value chains, thereby reducing gender inequality and advancing sustainableeconomic inclusion. 3. ACTIVITIES Activities and Results 1: Strengthened design and production and capacity for recycled products ⁃ Assess current production capacity and product value chain ⁃ Conduct project kick-off workshop and share baseline results ⁃ Support group in developing internal regulations and safety standards ⁃ Organize training courses on creative recycled product design and workplace safety ⁃ Provide technical assistance for product development Activities and Results 2: Improvedmarket access through online/offline sales and Communications. ⁃ Online sales training ⁃ Product consignment in souvenir shops and hotels ⁃ Product showcase events at tourist attractions Activities and Results 3: Branding and Communication developments ⁃ Design brand identity (logo, packaging, slogan, product story) ⁃ Establish and manage online communication channels (Facebook, TikTok,Shopee/Lazada store) ⁃ Produce media content (videos, photos, stories) ⁃ Organize public campaigns on green tourism and gender equality Activities and Results 4: Enhanced management and operational capacity of production group. ⁃ Business planning and management training ⁃ Business plans building ⁃ Final project evaluation ⁃ Final project workshop and results sharing 4. PROJECT AREAS: Hope Vocational Training Center for People with Disabilities (HOPE) – 69 Thach Han Street, Phu Xuan Ward, Hue City 5. DURATION: 18 months 6. TARGET GROUPS/BENEFICIARIES: Women with disabilities and other vulnerable groups

participating-org.narrative: Center of Research and Inclusive Development Action (IDEA) is a non-profit organization established in 2006, whose aim is to inherit and promote the mission, values, and achievements of the disability forum in improving the position and capacity of people with disabilities. The main activities aim at a barrier-free commune for the rights of people with disabilities in general and women with disabilities in particular. IDEA (Center of Research and Inclusive Development Action ) was established in 2006 under the Center for Creative Science and Technology (VFST). Mission: To encourage people with disabilities to integrate for a barrier-free society and create opportunities for people with disabilities to participate in all activities of equal development because of the RIGHTS of persons with disabilities. The Disability Forum is the information network of IDEA, it was established in 2000 as a network connecting Vietnamese disability groups with international non-governmental organizations. The goal of theforum is to increase the ability to integrate and eliminate national barriers of People with Disabilities through activities such as information provision, training for People with Disabilities, NGOs and international organizations.
